title: Fast relative-strength ratio breakout vs BTC/ETH/BNB, flat within the day

source.title: Ratio Charts (LuxAlgo library), via lab hypothesis H-047

rule_summary: Chart 1h, closed bars only. For traded pair X, Y = geometric mean of the 1h closes of the pairs among BTC/USDT, ETH/USDT, BNB/USDT other than X (all three when X is another pair), loaded as informative pairs; R = close_X / Y. ENTRY: R > SMA(40) of R AND R >= max R of the last 10 bars including t AND close_X > SMA(40) of close_X AND no open position AND 1 bar since last exit. EXIT at bar close when R < SMA(4) of R OR close_X < SMA(40). STOP: fixed 2% below entry (native). No take-profit. DAY-TRADE FRAME (same for every fast variant): entries only on bars opening 00:00-16:00 UTC, at most 2 entries per pair per UTC day; any open position is sold at the open of the 23:00 UTC bar or 12 hourly bars after entry, whichever comes first (never held overnight). Long only, spot, one position per pair, no pyramiding.
mechanism: A pair that breaks to a short-horizon high of its ratio to the majors is gaining relative strength; the parent's 20-day SMA, 5-day high and 2-day exit compressed by 12 capture the same leadership over hours. Fast variant of a tried rule: the parent holds days or weeks; this one is forced flat within the day so the dry-run reaches 60 trades in weeks. Costs (0.30% round trip) are NOT relaxed.
